isoc_eb_ai.label: Artificial intelligence by size class of enterprise

isoc_eb_ain2.label: Artificial intelligence by NACE Rev. 2 activity

indic_is.E_AI_TTM: Enterprises using AI technologies performing analysis of written language (text mining)
indic_is.E_AI_TSR: Enterprises using AI technologies converting spoken language into machine-readable format (speech recognition)
indic_is.E_AI_TNLG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating written or spoken language or programming codes (natural language generation, speech synthesis)
indic_is.E_AI_TIR: Enterprises using AI technologies identifying objects or persons based on images (image recognition, image processing)
indic_is.E_AI_TML: Enterprises using machine learning (e.g. deep learning) for data analysis
indic_is.E_AI_TPA: Enterprises using AI technologies automating different workflows or assisting in decision making (AI based software robotic process automation)
indic_is.E_AI_TAR: Enterprises using AI technologies enabling physical movement of machines via autonomous decisions based on observation of surroundings (autonomous robots, self-driving vehicles, autonomous drones)
indic_is.E_AI_TANY: Enterprises using at least one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TX: Enterprises don't use any of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TGE2: Enterprises using at least two of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_TGE3: Enterprises using at least three of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_PMS: Enterprises using AI technologies for marketing or sales
indic_is.E_AI_PPP: Enterprises using AI technologies for production processes
indic_is.E_AI_PBA: Enterprises using AI technologies for organisation of business administration processes
indic_is.E_AI_PME: Enterprises using AI technologies for management of enterprises
indic_is.E_AI_PLOG: Enterprises using AI technologies for logistics
indic_is.E_AI_PITS: Enterprises using AI technologies for ICT security
indic_is.E_AI_PHR: Enterprises using AI technologies for human resources management or recruiting
indic_is.E_AI_ADOWN: Enterprises' AI technologies were developed by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_AMOWN: Enterprises' AI technologies were commercial software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_AOS: Enterprises' AI technologies were open-source software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_ARDY: Enterprises' AI technologies were commercial software or systems ready to use
indic_is.E_AI_AEXT: Enterprises' AI technologies were  developed or modified by external providers
indic_is.E_AI_EC: Enterprises that ever considered to use one of the AI technologies: AI_TTM, AI_TSR, AI_TNLG, AI_TIR, AI_TML, AI_TPA, AI_TAR, E_AI_TPVSG
indic_is.E_AI_BCST: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because the costs seem too high
indic_is.E_AI_BLE: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of relevant expertise
indic_is.E_AI_BINC: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of incompatibility with existing equipment, software or systems
indic_is.E_AI_BDDT: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of difficulties with availability or quality of the necessary data
indic_is.E_AI_BCDP: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of concerns regarding violation of data protection and privacy
indic_is.E_AI_BLEG: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of a lack of clarity about the legal consequences
indic_is.E_AI_BEC: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because of ethical considerations
indic_is.E_AI_BNU: Enterprises do not use AI technologies, because artificial Intelligence technologies are not useful for Enterprise
indic_is.E_AI_DA: Enterprises use AI technologies and perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AI_CC: Enterprises use AI technologies and buy any cloud computing services used over the internet
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DASANY: Enterprises use AI technologies or buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services or perform data analytics on data from any source
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DASGE3: Enterprises use AI technologies or buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services or perform data analytics on data from at least three sources
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DASANY2: Enterprises use AI technologies or buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services or perform data analytics on data from any source among E_DASWEB, E_DASLOC, E_DASSDS, E_DASGOV and E_DASSAT
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DA_ANY: Enterprises use AI technologies or buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services or perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DA: Enterprises use AI technologies and buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services and perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AIX_CC1SI_DA: Enterprises buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services and perform data analytics, but don't use AI technologies
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SIX_DA: Enterprises use AI technologies and perform data analytics, but don't buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SI_DAX: Enterprises use AI technologies and buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services, but don't perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AIX_CC1SIX_DA: Enterprises perform data analytics, but don't use AI technologies and don't buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services
indic_is.E_AIX_CC1SI_DAX: Enterprises buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services, but don't use AI technologies and don't perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AI_CC1SIX_DAX: Enterprises use AI technologies, but don't buy sophisticated or intermediate cloud computing services and don't perform data analytics
indic_is.E_AI_PBAM: Enterprises using AI technologies for organisation of business administration processes or management
indic_is.E_AI_PFIN: Enterprises using AI technologies for accounting, controlling or finance management
indic_is.E_AI_PRDI: Enterprises using AI technologies for research and development (R&D) or innovation activity
indic_is.E_AI_P1ANY: Enterprises using AI technologies for at least one of the purposes: AI_PMS, AI_PPP, AI_PBAM, AI_PLOG, AI_PITS, AI_PFIN, AI_PRDI
indic_is.E_AI_P1GE2: Enterprises using AI technologies for at least two of the purposes: AI_PMS, AI_PPP, AI_PBAM, AI_PLOG, AI_PITS, AI_PFIN, AI_PRDI
indic_is.E_AI_P1GE3: Enterprises using AI technologies for at least three of the purposes: AI_PMS, AI_PPP, AI_PBAM, AI_PLOG, AI_PITS, AI_PFIN, AI_PRDI
indic_is.E_DI3_VLO_AI_TANY: Enterprises with very low digital intensity index, which use any artificial intelligence technology
indic_is.E_DI3_LO_AI_TANY: Enterprises with low digital intensity index, which use any artificial intelligence technology
indic_is.E_DI3_HI_AI_TANY: Enterprises with high digital intensity index, which use any artificial intelligence technology
indic_is.E_DI3_VHI_AI_TANY: Enterprises with very high digital intensity index, which use any artificial intelligence technology
indic_is.E_AI_PDI: Enterprises which process data on individuals using AI technologies
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI technologies for possible biases towards individuals
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS_ADOWN: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI for possible biases towards individuals, and their AI technologies were developed by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS_AMOWN: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI for possible biases towards individuals, and their AI technologies were commercial software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS_AOS: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI for possible biases towards individuals, and their AI technologies were open-source software or systems modified by own employees
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS_ARDY: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI for possible biases towards individuals, and their AI technologies were purchased commercial software or systems ready to use
indic_is.E_AI_BIAS_AEXT: Enterprises which have measures to check the results generated by AI for possible biases towards individuals, and their AI technologies were developed or modified by external providers
indic_is.E_AI_TPVSG: Enterprises using AI technologies generating pictures, videos, sound/audio

nace_r2.C10-S951_X_K: All activities (except agriculture, forestry and fishing, and mining and quarrying), without financial sector
nace_r2.C10-C12: Manufacture of food products; beverages and tobacco products
nace_r2.C13-C15: Manufacture of textiles, wearing apparel, leather and related products
nace_r2.C16-C18: Manufacture of wood, paper, printing and reproduction
nace_r2.C19-C23: Manufacture of coke, refined petroleum, chemical and basic pharmaceutical products, rubber and plastics, other non-metallic mineral products
nace_r2.C20: Manufacture of chemicals and chemical products
nace_r2.C21: Manufacture of basic pharmaceutical products and pharmaceutical preparations
nace_r2.C22_C23: Manufacture of rubber and plastic products and other non-metallic mineral products
nace_r2.C24_C25: Manufacture of basic metals and fabricated metal products, except machinery and equipment
nace_r2.C26: Manufacture of computer, electronic and optical products
nace_r2.C27_C28: Manufacture of electrical equipment, machinery and equipment n.e.c.
nace_r2.C28: Manufacture of machinery and equipment n.e.c.
nace_r2.C29_C30: Manufacture of motor vehicles, trailers, semi-trailers and of other transport equipment
nace_r2.C31-C33: Manufacture of furniture; jewellery, musical instruments, toys; repair and installation of machinery and equipment

unit.PC_ENT_AI_EC: Percentage of the enterprises which ever considered to use any of the AI technologies
unit.PC_ENT_AI_TANY: Percentage of the enterprises using at least one AI technologies
